decided: Opening, your pick: the fired-trainer clip from its first frame under "Fire your trainer now and replace him with AI." (3.4 s of its 4.0 s, its own speed, never stretched), then a hard cut to you close on "Why are thousands".

Framing: the Cheat Code's wider pair converted to this roll by your head size (close 738x1312, wide 918x1632). Checked side by side with the approved Cheat Code frames: you fill the frame the same way. RA-05's tighter conversion of the same pick (648/810) was tighter than the Cheat Code on both shots, so I did not use it.

Colour: the Cheat Code's golden-skin colour file as is. On this roll your face measures 117 to 120 against 113 to 120 on the approved Cheat Code frames. RA-05's re-made version for this roll came out a stop darker (91 to 96) and duller, so I did not use it.

Voice: the bass lift (+3 dB at 120 Hz) on this roll's fitted voice, same music, -14.2 LUFS. The audio check passes 11 of 12; the tone row misses by 0.36 dB at its worst band, which is the bass lift itself (the approved Cheat Code mix misses the same row).

Every pause cut on this roll is visible on its own (I measured all 16), so every one gets a size change. The three numbered points became one pattern: close on "One," "Two," and "And three,", wide for the point. The "One," and "Two," shots are 0.4 s each; say if they feel too quick and I will hold the close shot through the point instead.
With I1 gone, the paper line is you: close on "A paper from your trainer that says goal,", wide on "lose 20 pounds, does not." (I1 used to hide a pause cut there).

Each signpost's headline now appears on the number you say ("One," "Two," "three"). On my first build it waited for "AI can...", and the glass strip sat empty over your chest for up to 0.9 s; a watch-through by Gemini caught it, I confirmed it frame by frame and fixed it.

The problem-then-fix run: Tweaked shoulder, Working out at home, Out of order, then both fixes on "AI adjusts your plan in seconds, while human trainers" (Shoulder fix 1.3 s, Hack squat 1.5 s), then Back next week. I did not offer each fix straight after its problem: the shoulder fix would get only "When you get injured" (0.8 s, under the 1.2 s minimum) and would push out the home workout clip.
The app's Swap list (T1) is out: the phone in the Shoulder fix carries "AI adjusts your plan".
"Leg squat machine" is drawn as a Smith machine (a barbell on two rails), so it reads as a different machine from the hack squat.
Shoulder fix END frame: the first version had one arm up and one down and read like a chest machine; I remade it once with both arms out to the sides.
Back next week has no follow-on clip: you said it is good as is.
Same sheet for everyone needed three takes (take 1: the stack of sheets turned into a black binder by itself; take 2: a second trainer appeared). Take 3 is clean for the part used.

The AI-GENERATED chips are placed by looking at each clip: on the wall above everyone in Same sheet for everyone (the automatic placement put it on the trainer's head), above his head in Tweaked shoulder and Back next week, beside his head in the home workout clip, on the floor in the fired-trainer clip.
The phone cards now move: the generation demo at normal speed, a slow push on the lock screen, and the real AI Trainer recording (Monday's list, then the Goblet Squat sheet and its demo).

The two library clips are upscaled with a standard resize and light sharpening. The sharper AI upscaler named in my notes is not installed on this Mac, and the 1080 copy of the fired-trainer clip from the Ad 13 build is slowed down, so I could not use it. They read slightly softer than the new clips.
Junk-footage scan of the kept takes: nothing confirmed. The two pause joins it flagged both sit on a clip cut.
Captions are round 1's, unchanged (same words and timing). They clear every graphic; every graphic clears your face by at least 373 px.
